nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner in Owned; set to msg.sender at deployment and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending new owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
ERC20 token symbol string ('Alaska').
ERC20 token name string ('Alaska Fan Token').
Constant token decimals (8) used in supply computation.
Total token supply state variable _totalSupply, initialized to TOKEN_SUPPLY_TOTAL.
Mapping of holder address to token balance; mutated by transfer, batchTransfer, transferFrom and burn.
Nested mapping of owner => spender => allowance; mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
Constant supplyNumber = 238000000000 used to derive the total token supply.
Constant powNumber = 10 used as the base for the supply exponentiation.
Constant TOKEN_SUPPLY_TOTAL = supplyNumber * powNumber ** decimals, the fixed token supply.
SafeMath.safeAdd: performs c = a + b with an overflow require; used for all balance credits.
SafeMath.safeSub: requires b <= a then computes c = a - b; used for all balance debits.
SafeMath.safeMul: multiplication with an overflow check.
SafeMath.safeDiv: division guarded by require(b > 0).
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing deployer as privileged owner.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner): onlyOwner guarded function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, emits OwnershipTransferred and finalizes ownership transfer.
_Token constructor: sets symbol/name, mints _totalSupply to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns the balance mapping value for the given address.
transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits msg.sender via safeSub and credits 'to' via safeAdd, then emits Transfer.
batchTransfer(address[] _receivers, uint256[] _amounts): loops over up to 100 receivers, accumulating totals and crediting balances.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): drains allowance and from-balance with safeSub and credits 'to' with safeAdd.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then invokes an arbitrary spender contract via receiveApproval, an attacker-controlled external call after state write.
Fallback payable function that unconditionally reverts, blocking plain ether transfers.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens): onlyOwner function performing an external call to an arbitrary ERC20 contract's transfer.
burn(uint256 _value): requires balance sufficiency then uses raw -= and += arithmetic on balances instead of SafeMath.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller address used for ownership, balance lookups and authorization checks.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to a caller-supplied contract after the allowance state update.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on a caller-supplied token contract; return value not validated.
Raw unchecked arithmetic balances[msg.sender] -= _value and balances[0x0] += _value bypassing SafeMath helpers.
Unsafe downcast cnt = (uint8)(cnt) and uint8 loop counter in batchTransfer, truncating the array length before iteration.

edges.reason: Owned constructor sets owner from msg.sender, granting the caller privileged ownership.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, a caller-controlled authorization gate.
_Token constructor mints the whole _totalSupply to the deployer msg.sender.
transfer uses msg.sender to read and debit the caller's balance.
batchTransfer debits balances[msg.sender] and uses it as the Transfer sender.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller as allowance owner.
transferFrom consumes allowed[from][msg.sender], keyed on the caller.
approveAndCall keys the allowance on msg.sender and forwards msg.sender into the external receiveApproval callback.
burn requires and debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller address.
The external receiveApproval call happens after allowed[msg.sender][spender] is written, letting the callee re-enter with an already-updated allowance.
approveAndCall reaches the attacker-controlled external call inside its body.
Malicious spender contract can call back into approveAndCall/transferFrom/transfer during receiveApproval, exploiting reentrancy.
The caller-supplied spender parameter determines the target contract of the external call.
Caller-supplied bytes data is forwarded verbatim into the arbitrary external receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress parameter is the caller-supplied contract targeted by ERC20Interface(...).transfer.
tokens parameter is passed into the external token transfer call.
transferAnyERC20Token executes the external call to the arbitrary token contract.
The arbitrary token contract invoked by transferAnyERC20Token can call back into this token's functions.
burn._value flows into the unchecked balances[msg.sender] -= _value operation.
burn performs raw += / -= on balances instead of the SafeMath helpers, relying only on a require guard.
_receivers.length is reduced into uint8 cnt via an unsafe downcast that can truncate the iteration count.
_amounts elements are indexed by the uint8-truncated counter inside the batch loops.
batchTransfer performs the uint8 cast of cnt and uses a uint8 loop counter.
Parameter a is summed into local c in safeAdd.
Parameter b is summed into local c in safeAdd.
Parameter a is the minuend in safeSub.
Parameter b is the subtrahend checked against a in safeSub.
Parameter a is a multiplicand in safeMul.
Parameter b is a multiplicand in safeMul.
Parameter a is the dividend in safeDiv.
Parameter b is the divisor guarded by require(b > 0) in safeDiv.
_newOwner parameter is written into the newOwner ownership state variable.
Recipient parameter to indexes balances for the credit.
tokens parameter is the debited/credited amount in transfer.
spender parameter keys the allowed mapping in approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value written in approve.
from parameter indexes the balance and allowance debited in transferFrom.
to parameter indexes the balance credited in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved in transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
tokenOwner parameter is the outer key of allowed in allowance.
spender parameter is the inner key of allowed in allowance.
tokens parameter is both written to allowed and forwarded to the external callback in approveAndCall.
transfer writes safeSub/safeAdd results into the balances mapping.
batchTransfer debits and credits entries of the balances mapping.
approve writes the spender allowance into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] with safeSub.
burn directly mutates balances entries with unchecked arithmetic.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before making the untrusted external call.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
batchTransfer calls safeAdd while accumulating totals and crediting receivers.
batchTransfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for both the from-balance and the allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
Constructor initializes _totalSupply from the constant TOKEN_SUPPLY_TOTAL.
TOKEN_SUPPLY_TOTAL constant is assigned into the _totalSupply state variable.
supplyNumber constant participates in computing TOKEN_SUPPLY_TOTAL.
powNumber constant is the exponent base used in TOKEN_SUPPLY_TOTAL.
decimals constant is the exponent used in TOKEN_SUPPLY_TOTAL.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply when reporting the supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
transferOwnership writes the new owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership checks msg.sender against the staged newOwner value.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against the owner state variable.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by onlyOwner, restricting the external sweep to the owner.
Accumulated batchTransfer totalAmount gates the single debit of the sender balance.
Local cnt bounds both batch loops and is unsafely narrowed to uint8.
Loop index i iterates the receivers/amounts arrays inside batchTransfer.
